I wrote `/tmp/psz-work/calib2/t1h_tickets/stock/2/priorities.csv` with the header `id,priority` and 40 rows, sorted by id.

I left out the 5 closed tickets: T-200, T-216, T-220, T-238 and T-242.

I applied the rules by hand, since this environment has no shell to run a script. Matching was whole-word and case-insensitive, so `downtime` did not count as `down`, `Breakdown` did not count as `down`, and `Refunded` did not count as `refund`. Those tickets fell through to P4 or P3 as the rules direct. I did not re-check the output against a script.
